interpretation: Global tile and central-cell quantities are reported separately. The former uses the full nine-cell domain; central-cell liquid volume fractions use only the central native cell. Case A treats Ti3SiC2 as zero-capacity/zero-conductivity insulation, and adiabatic cooling redistributes energy internally rather than losing heat to an environment.
